description: Update a player profile's settings. Changes EVERY video linked to the profile. Covers: player colors (colors.primaryColor / controlsColor), enabled controls list, smart autoplay (vsl.smartAutoplay), VSL mode (vsl.disablePause / disableForward / alternativeProgress), playback speed (general.default_speed), save progress, theme and gear menu (general.theme / general.settingsControls), offline (general.video_offline_enabled…), availableQualities, and CAPTION APPEARANCE: text/background colors (colors.captionsColor / captionsBackgroundColor, hex with #, alpha allowed) and size by name (captionsSize: extra_small | small | normal | large | extra_large — use the user's word). Colors are merged with the current ones (only the colors you send change); general is merged too. controls, vsl, saveProgress and availableQualities REPLACE the current value — send the complete object/list. Do NOT use this tool for: chapters (use panda_update_video_config), subtitle generation (use panda_generate_ai_subtitles), thumbnails, or title/description (use panda_update_video).

availableQualities.description: Qualities the viewer can pick, e.g. ["480p","720p","1080p"]. Empty list = all qualities.

captionsSize.description: Caption font size by the dashboard name: extra_small (10px), small (12px), normal (14px, default), large (16px), extra_large (18px). Use the user's word ('legenda grande' / 'large captions' → large).

colors.description: Player colors, including caption text/background. Only the colors you send change — the others are kept.

captionsBackgroundColor.description: Caption background color — #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA with transparency (e.g. '#000000B3' = 70% opaque black).

captionsColor.description: Caption (subtitle) text color — #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA with transparency (e.g. '#FFFFFFFF' = opaque white).

controls.description: Array of enabled player controls (incl. "play-large" = Botão de Play Grande). Values: "play-large", "rewind", "play", "fast-forward", "progress", "current-time", "volume", "captions", "settings", "pip", "fullscreen", "airplay", "cast"

exclusive.description: Dedicate/restrict the profile to a single video

general.description: General player settings (speed, search-in-video, theme, gear menu, offline). Merged into the current values — keys you omit are kept.

expire_in_days_video.description: Days an offline download stays available

external_link_button_enabled.description: Show an external link button in the offline app

searchInsideVideo.description: Enable smart search inside the video (same semantic as legacy smartSearch).

settingsControls.description: Items of the gear (settings) menu. The profile stores the whole object — send all four.

captionsLanguage.description: Caption language item in the gear menu

dubbing.description: Dubbing (audio track) item in the gear menu

quality.description: Quality item in the gear menu

speed.description: Speed item in the gear menu

smartSearch.description: (Legacy) Enable smart search in video. v2 sends `searchInsideVideo` — both accepted.

startsWithSubtitle.description: Whether the video starts with the subtitle track visible by default.

theme.description: Player theme: auto, dark or light.

video_offline_enabled.description: Allow offline viewing in the Panda app for the videos of this profile

initQuality.description: Initial video quality (e.g. 720). Must be one of availableQualities when that list is set.

vsl.description: VSL (Video Sales Letter) settings — controls autoplay, smart autoplay, fake progress bar, muted indicator

alternativeProgress2xLimit.description: Percentage at which fake progress accelerates

alternativeProgressHeight.description: Fake progress bar height in px

smartAutoplay.description: Smart Autoplay — auto-plays muted, unmutes on interaction

name: panda_update_profile
title: Update Profile
